dict.Cât de opacă e ștampila (mai puțin = se: How opaque the stamp is (less = the text underneath shows through)
dict.Rândul mic de sub text (data, ora, numel: The small line under the text (date, time, name); it can stay empty
dict.Textul mare al ștampilei (de exemplu PLĂ: The large text of the stamp (for example PAID)
dict.Trage ca să mărești sau să micșorezi (cu: Drag to enlarge or shrink (with Shift, without keeping proportions)
dict.Trage ca să muți; dublu-clic ca să schim: Drag to move; double-click to change the stamp
dict.Ce se vede prin carouri e transparent: Whatever shows the checkerboard is transparent
dict.Fotografiază sau scanează ștampila (ori: Photograph or scan the stamp (or signature) on a white sheet. The paper becomes transparent, the ink keeps its color, and the picture is cropped to the drawing. The stamp is kept in “My stamps” on this computer.
dict.Mai mult: scoate și umbrele sau hârtia m: More: also removes shadows or darker paper; less: also keeps very light ink
